+    :param validate_nesting: Check that every child context created
+        with :meth:`_make_sub_context` has been closed before this
+        context is closed, and raise :exc:`RuntimeError` naming the
+        open ones if not. Child contexts inherit the setting. Disabled
+        by default.
 
     .. versionchanged:: 8.2
+        Added the ``validate_nesting`` parameter.
+
         The ``protected_args`` attribute is deprecated and will be removed in
         Click 9.0. ``args`` will contain remaining unparsed tokens.
 
@@ -280,6 +287,7 @@ class Context:
         token_normalize_func: t.Callable[[str], str] | None = None,
         color: bool | None = None,
         show_default: bool | None = None,
+        validate_nesting: bool = False,
     ) -> None:
         #: the parent context or `None` if none exists.
         self.parent = parent
@@ -427,6 +435,13 @@ class Context:
         #: Show option default values when formatting help text.
         self.show_default: bool | None = show_default
 
+        #: Whether closing this context checks that its child contexts
+        #: were closed first.
+        self.validate_nesting: bool = validate_nesting
+        #: Child contexts made with :meth:`_make_sub_context` that are
+        #: still open. Only filled while :attr:`validate_nesting` is on.
+        self._child_contexts: list[Context] = []
+
         self._close_callbacks: list[t.Callable[[], t.Any]] = []
         self._depth = 0
         self._parameter_source: dict[str, ParameterSource] = {}
@@ -477,9 +492,12 @@ class Context:
         tb: TracebackType | None,
     ) -> None:
         self._depth -= 1
-        if self._depth == 0:
-            self.close()
-        pop_context()
+        try:
+            if self._depth == 0:
+                self.close()
+        finally:
+            # A refused close must not leave this context on the stack.
+            pop_context()
 
     @contextmanager
     def scope(self, cleanup: bool = True) -> cabc.Iterator[Context]:
@@ -606,10 +624,51 @@ class Context:
         """Invoke all close callbacks registered with
         :meth:`call_on_close`, and exit all context managers entered
         with :meth:`with_resource`.
+
+        If :attr:`validate_nesting` is enabled and a child context made
+        with :meth:`_make_sub_context` is still open, nothing is closed
+        and :exc:`RuntimeError` is raised, so the child can be closed
+        and this call made again.
+
+        .. versionchanged:: 8.2
+            Raises :exc:`RuntimeError` for open child contexts when
+            :attr:`validate_nesting` is enabled.
         """
-        self._exit_stack.close()
-        # In case the context is reused, create a new exit stack.
-        self._exit_stack = ExitStack()
+        if self.validate_nesting:
+            self._check_children_closed()
+
+        try:
+            self._exit_stack.close()
+        finally:
+            # In case the context is reused, create a new exit stack.
+            self._exit_stack = ExitStack()
+            self._forget_in_parent()
+
+    def _check_children_closed(self) -> None:
+        """Raise :exc:`RuntimeError` naming the child contexts that are
+        still open.
+        """
+        if not self._child_contexts:
+            return
+
+        names = ", ".join(
+            repr(child.info_name or child.command.name or "<unnamed>")
+            for child in self._child_contexts
+        )
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Cannot close context {self.info_name!r} while child contexts"
+            f" are still open: {names}. Close child contexts before their"
+            " parent."
+        )
+
+    def _forget_in_parent(self) -> None:
+        """Stop the parent from tracking this context as an open child."""
+        parent = self.parent
+
+        if parent is not None and parent._child_contexts:
+            parent._child_contexts = [
+                child for child in parent._child_contexts if child is not self
+            ]
 
     @property
     def command_path(self) -> str:
@@ -728,7 +787,19 @@ class Context:
 
         :meta private:
         """
-        return type(self)(command, info_name=command.name, parent=self)
+        extra: dict[str, t.Any] = {}
+
+        # Only passed when on, so a Context subclass whose __init__ does
+        # not know the parameter keeps working.
+        if self.validate_nesting:
+            extra["validate_nesting"] = True
+
+        child = type(self)(command, info_name=command.name, parent=self, **extra)
+
+        if self.validate_nesting:
+            self._child_contexts.append(child)
+
+        return child
 
     @t.over
